summary: Install the Edge Manager CLI by enabling ansible-automation-platform-2.5-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms and running dnf install flightctl; with the manual OAuth setup also install a browser opener such as xdg-utils (xdg-open, x-www-browser or www-browser).
questions: How do I install the flightctl CLI?
Which repository has the Red Hat Edge Manager CLI?
Why does flightctl login need xdg-open?
